stops.note: to throw forward, from pro- (forward) and iacere (to throw), with irregular past participle projectus
formed for an object thrown or launched forward
stops.meaning: an object thrown or launched forward

stops.note: adopted directly for an object propelled through the air
stops.meaning: an object propelled through the air, such as a missile

current_meaning: an object propelled through the air by force, such as a missile or thrown item
